construct: CYP11B1 normally converts 11-deoxycortisol to cortisol and 11-deoxycorticosterone to corticosterone. Deficiency lowers cortisol, increases ACTH and adrenal androgen production, and causes accumulation of mineralocorticoid-active 11-deoxycorticosterone, leading to hypertension, hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis, and suppressed renin.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Virilization with low cortisol, high adrenal androgens, hypertension, hypokalemia, and low renin indicates 11β-hydroxylase deficiency; blocked 11-deoxycortisol→cortisol and DOC→corticosterone reactions cause DOC accumulation.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: 21-hydroxylase, CYP17A1/17,20-lyase, aldosterone synthase, and cholesterol side-chain cleavage defects produce distinct steroid profiles. DOC-mediated low-renin hypertension plus androgen excess makes CYP11B1 uniquely correct.
